laws.rc: RC regen law: min(max, stored+elapsed-regen)/max over a 5-day window; floor 8% (measured sovereign gate)
laws.vp: VP effective floor 35% (R289 measured); effective vests = own + received − delegated-out (T-85 meter truth)
laws.weight: steem units 0 < weight ≤ 10000 (u16 overflow downvote bug stays dead)
laws.spacing: ≥3300ms between a soldier's votes (STEEM_MIN_VOTE_INTERVAL_SEC measured 3s + margin)
laws.dayBudget: max(state, chain) per soldier per UTC day (T-18 chain-truth law); cap 20/day (R290 measured step-up)
laws.externalOnly: the full roster is excluded as author — curation of the outside world; fleet-support stays army-social's law
